mission: Mara and Tresina Lobi plan their Toryaz meeting — the on-page establishment of a thirty-year friendship.
why_now: Tresina is attending Toryaz as Jedi observer and has asked Mara to come along.
opening_hook: Mara and Tresina on a Coruscant balcony with afternoon caf between them.
conflict: Mara's operational instincts (something is off) vs. Tresina's long-standing insistence on treating Mara as a friend rather than a weapon.
turning_point: Mara agrees to attend Toryaz — for Tresina's company as much as for the summit.
closing_hook: Tresina laughing at a joke of Mara's — a rare sound in the book.
setting: Coruscant terrace (Jedi Temple observation deck), afternoon.
sensory_details: Late-afternoon light on the Temple spires; caf cups on a low table; Tresina's warm laugh.
emotional_trajectory: Professional exchange → personal warmth → committed attendance.
canon_elements_needed: Tresina Lobi as Chalactan Jedi Master
action_beats: Mara and Tresina meet on the terrace
notes: Allston plants the friendship exactly as long as the bombing will require.
